features.name: A Breath Felt in a Hurricane

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: 9 affinity [damage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage). The [damage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage) ignores [immunity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-immunity). The affected area becomes [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain). An enemy has affinity [weakness](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-weakness) 5 while occupying an affected square.

features.target: Each enemy and object in the area
